item.title: Two Martin County brush fires contained as Florida Forest Service warns of more to come this summer
item.description:
Martin County saw two brush fires this week, including one sparked by a lightning strike. Both are now fully contained and being monitored by the Florida Forest Service.

item.description: Tioniea Hines, 22, is in St. Lucie County Jail on $75,000 bond.

item.title: TCCEED summer internship program places 61 Treasure Coast students in paid local jobs
item.description: The second-year TCCEED summer internship program doubled employer participation and placed 61 students in paid positions across the Treasure Coast.

item.title: Port St. Lucie's 6,000-seat soccer stadium to break ground in November at Walton & One development
item.description: Professional soccer club Port St. Lucie SC released new stadium renderings and announced November groundbreaking for a 6,000-seat venue at Walton & One on U.S. 1 and Walton Road.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with panoramic ocean views
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, offers a 105-step climb to panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet, and Loxahatchee and Indian rivers.

item.title: Linda Noskova recovers from five blown match points to win Wimbledon women's title
item.description: 21-year-old Linda Noskova recovered from a second-set meltdown to overcome Karolina Muchova 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 in an all-Czech final on Saturday for her first Grand Slam trophy.
